finance_briefs.title: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since 2007 as Fed rate-hike expectations rise
finance_briefs.summary: The sell-off in U.S. government debt is deepening as investors increasingly price in an interest rate hike this week.

finance_briefs.title: Iranian foreign minister will head to China for talks, as Pentagon reveals financial cost of war
finance_briefs.summary: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araqchi will visit China on Wednesday for talks, Beijing's foreign ministry announced on Tuesday.

finance_briefs.title: U.S. seeks to seize $61 million of crypto it claims are proceeds from Iranian petroleum sales to Chinese buyers
finance_briefs.summary: Two Chinese companies, are alleged to have used trading accounts in Binance to launder the illicit proceeds and funnel the funds to Tehran or its proxies.

finance_briefs.title: What to watch as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testifies before Congress
finance_briefs.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent may face questions on rising energy prices, Federal Reserve policy, government debt and the Trump team's economic agenda.

finance_briefs.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to lift block on U.S. Postal Service mail-in ballots rule
finance_briefs.summary: Justice Brett Kavanaugh said that applying the U.S. Postal Service rule in the 2026 midterm elections "would be arbitrary and capricious."

politics_briefs.title: NATO jets down drone in Lithuanian airspace
politics_briefs.summary: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.

politics_briefs.title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
politics_briefs.summary: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used

politics_briefs.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
politics_briefs.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
